notes.title: V1.02 Bug Fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed a major bug with the keypad that if the player pauses the cursor would disappear 

- Fixed more particle issues

- Fixed the key in the light switch puzzle being really difficult to grab, should be really easy to get now

notes.title: V1.01 Patch!
notes.content:
[h2]First of all thank you all so much for playing the game and giving feedback, it means a lot to me :)[/h2]

- [b]Fixed a number of small issues that were found on release[/b]

- [b]Added Widescreen support[/b] (There was an issue with the main menu on widescreen displays, this should hopefully be fixed now

- Fixed some [b]particle issues[/b] that were happening in certain loops
